android.desc:
The NOS has developed a special NOS Teletext application for Android devices. With this application it is possible to quickly access the NOS Teletext pages, such as the current general and financial news, traffic information and sports results.

Please note: the design of the Teletext app on AndroidTV is not optimized for wide screens. The app shows black borders on both sides of the screen on AndroidTV.

quotes.text:
The Dutch national broastcaster upgraded their Teletext infrastructure (which was still running on old tech from the 80s) back in 2023: https://over.nos.nl/nieuws/teletekst-kan-weer-jaren-vooruit-met-nieuw-systeem/

The website (https://nos.nl/teletekst/101) and app (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eoffice.android) are very popular (no ads on either), but so is the website which covers a fraction of a modern browser's screen.

There's something about the short-form just-the-facts writing that makes information and news much easier to read than the puff pieces you find on many websites these days.
